thread:
vikram: Heads-up — we have a VPC/private deploy for customer Mistral tonight. Planning to start at 00:30 UTC, estimated 45m. Posting quick coordination + smoke checklist. @elaine @cj please confirm you can be on the handoff call.

elaine: I can join for the first 30m (00:25–00:55 UTC). Will be on my phone. Share the rollback trigger.

cj: I can be stand-by for the full window. Will monitor perf + load balancer.

maria: Ops note — infra changes include a subnet routing update and a KV migration using the rolling job. No DB schema changes.

vikram: Deploy owner: vikram (apply infra + deploy images). Secondary: cj (monitor/fallback). Oncall for customer: sam. Contact channel: #mistral-deploy (we'll open it when we start).

sam: I can take oncall for post-deploy smoke for 60m. Ping me for latency regressions.

vikram: Minimal smoke tests (run after canaries pass):
```
# run smoke script against private endpoint
curl -sS -X POST https://private-mistral.example/api/v1/predict -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .status
```
Expect status = "ok" and p50 < 120ms for simple prompts.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary cluster created (canary-3), image tag: mistral-release-2026-09-05. Canary health: initializing.

elaine: Code review note — I pushed one small tweak to the rollout config: reduce canary batch to 5% and extend canary time to 8 minutes. Verified in PR 4521. Please merge before handoff.

vikram: Will merge PR 4521 at 00:05 UTC and kick off the orchestration. Quick checklist for everyone before we start:
- merge PR and confirm image tag in deploy-bot
- ensure canary cluster health is green
- CJ: verify LB draining rules set to 300s
- Sam: be ready to run smoke script and escalate if p50 > 300ms
- Elaine: have rollback PR ready (config toggle revert)

cj: LB draining already set to 300s in staging; will double-check prod at 00:10 UTC.

elaine: Rollback command (to run from deploy pipeline UI):
```
# toggle the rollout flag back to previous variant
redwoodctl rollout set --env mistral-prod --flag model.variant=stable --reason "rollback: post-deploy regression"
```
Make sure auth to redwoodctl is available.

maria: KV migration note — it's online-compatible but will add 2–3% extra tail latency for ~10 minutes. Plan to schedule migration 10 minutes after canary completes.

vikram: Timeline recap: merge @ 00:05 -> canary start 00:20 -> canary finish 00:30 -> full rollout 00:30–00:50 -> KV migration 00:40. If anything abnormal, rollback window until 01:15 UTC.

sam: I'll run the smoke script at 00:32 and post results. If p50 > 250ms or error rate > 0.8% I'll call rollback.

cj: Confirmed — I'll keep an eye on LB metrics and open the logs view. If I see >5% 5xxs during canary I will pause rollout.

vikram: Thanks. Small ask: if you're going to be offline during window, reply here now. Otherwise I'll assume you're available.

elaine: Good to go. I'll be near laptop.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: merge PR 4521 @ 00:05 UTC.

vikram: Perfect — I'll post status updates in this thread and the #mistral-deploy channel once we start. See you tonight. :thumbsup:
